settings.question: How does the bundle pricing work?
settings.answer: One squishy is £9.99. Add any two to your basket and you pay £16.99; add any three and you pay just £19.99. Mix and match any styles — the discount applies automatically at checkout, no code needed.

settings.question: What is a slow-rise squishy?
settings.answer: Squishies are made from ultra-soft polyurethane foam. Squeeze one and it slowly rises back to its original shape over about five seconds — the satisfying part that makes them so good for fidgeting and stress relief.
